skills.name: Bullseye Marketing
skills.summary: Find three marketing channel bets through a founder interview, product evidence and focused two-week tests.
inputs: Goal, cash budget and team capacity
Product/GTM files, source links or a written brief
outputs: Three test candidates with evidence and CAC assumptions
skills.start_prompt: Use $bullseye-marketing for my product. Interview me first and ask for my product and GTM sources before recommending channels.
